layout.arrangement: White slide with a large red title 'Precision' at the top center-left. Below the title, the left two-thirds of the slide form a stacked explanation column: a gray definition band, a pale-yellow 'Meaning' band, a red-outlined formula box with a light-blue worked-example box to its right, two small callout boxes with a green curly brace beneath them, a red italic caption, and a blue-bordered italic note box at the bottom-left. The right third of the slide contains two stacked blue-framed confusion-matrix tables (top-right and mid-right) with a yellow circular badge '8' overlapping the top-right corner of the upper table. The bottom-right quadrant holds a large red-framed tree diagram with two fish illustrations, colored circular nodes and branch arrows. A thin black horizontal bar (video/crop artifact) runs along the very bottom edge.

layout.hierarchy: The oversized bold red title 'Precision' dominates first. Second in visual weight are the two blue-framed confusion matrices on the right (strong blue borders, saturated green and purple cell highlights) and the large red-framed tree panel. The left column is a descending stack of medium-weight blocks: gray definition band, yellow 'Meaning' band, red-outlined formula, and the blue note box. Color coding is consistent: red = positive/predicted-positive emphasis, green = negative/true-negative, blue = borders and key emphasis words, purple = highlighted numeric cells.

visual_elements.description: Top-right confusion matrix inside a thin blue rectangular frame. Above the table, centered over the two data columns, red bold text 'Predicted as'. The table has a header row with bold black 'P' and 'N', and a left stub column with bold black 'P' and 'N'; to the left of the stub column, red bold 'Actual' rotated 90 degrees (reading bottom-to-top). All table lines are red. Data cells: row P / column P = 'TP' on a bright green fill; row P / column N = 'FN' on white; row N / column P = 'FP' on white; row N / column N = 'TN' on a bright green fill. Cell text is bold black.

Second confusion matrix directly below the first, also inside a thin blue rectangular frame. Red bold 'Predicted as' centered above the data columns; bold black column headers 'P' and 'N'; bold black stub-column entries 'P' and 'N'; red bold 'Actual' rotated 90 degrees on the left. Red table lines. Data cells: row P / column P = '10' shown as white text inside a solid purple/indigo filled circle; row P / column N = '20' in plain black text on white; row N / column P = '2' in black text inside a purple rounded-rectangle outline; row N / column N = '68' in black text on a bright green fill.

Bottom-right red-framed panel showing a classification tree. Top headers: 'Positive' in bold red (left) and 'Negative' in bold green (right). Under each header is a gray line-art fish illustration (the left fish is a plain fish outline with faint internal markings; the right fish is a similar outline containing a row of small circles along its body). Below the positive fish: a solid red circle labeled '30' in white, with two thin blue arrows branching down-left and down-right to a solid red circle labeled '10' (white text) and a solid green circle labeled '20' (white text). Below the negative fish: a solid green circle labeled '70' in white, with two thin blue arrows branching down-left and down-right to a solid green circle labeled '68' (white text) and a solid red circle labeled '2' (white text). Captions beneath the leaf circles: 'TP' under 10, 'FN' under 20, 'TN' under 68, 'FP' under 2. A solid unlabeled red circle sits at the bottom center of the panel between the TP and FN captions. Two hollow red arrows (outlined, pointing downward and slightly inward) flank the tree at the far left and far right of the panel.

Formula block: white rounded rectangle with a thick red outline containing bold black 'Precision =' on the left and a fraction on the right — numerator 'TP', horizontal fraction bar, denominator 'TP + FP'.

Two small callout boxes beneath the formula, each with a pale-yellow triangular pointer rising to the formula box: left box pale yellow with bold black two-line text 'Positive' / 'Classified as +ive'; right box pale peach with bold black two-line text 'Negative' / 'Classified as +ive'. A green curly brace (horizontal, opening upward) spans beneath both boxes.
Yellow filled circle badge containing the black numeral '8', overlapping the top-right corner of the upper confusion matrix's blue frame.

typography_notes: All text is sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title 'Precision' is very large (~40 pt) bold red. Body text is bold black in the gray definition band (~16-17 pt). The 'Meaning' heading is bold red (~18 pt); the meaning sentence is bold black (~16 pt) with red underlined 'Predicted' and bold blue 'POSITIVE'. The formula uses bold black text with a stacked fraction. The worked-example box uses bold black text with bold blue '= 83.3%'. The two callout boxes use small bold black text (~10-11 pt) on two lines. 'All Samples classified as Positive' is red italic (~13 pt). The bottom note box is blue italic (~13-14 pt) with bold 'DOES NOT', bold underlined 'more', and bold 'HIGHLY'. Confusion-matrix headers 'Predicted as' and 'Actual' are bold red (~12-13 pt); 'Actual' is rotated 90 degrees. Matrix cell text is bold black (~12-13 pt). Tree panel headers 'Positive' (red) and 'Negative' (green) are bold (~15 pt); node numbers are white bold inside colored circles; TP/FN/TN/FP captions are small bold black (~11 pt).
animation_state: No obvious mid-build animation; all major elements (both confusion matrices, the tree diagram, the note box, and the badge '8') appear simultaneously visible. The yellow '8' badge may be a persistent overlay from the video player rather than slide content.
